name: The Game Quick and Easy

endCondition.description: Ends when all 50 number cards are laid (win) or the active player cannot legally lay a card (loss)

categories.label: Team won (all 50 cards laid)
categories.labelVi: Cả đội thắng (đã đặt hết 50 lá)
categories.hint: Win only if every number card is laid on the two stacks

categories.label: Cards laid on the stacks (of 50)
categories.hint: Count cards on both stacks, ideally 50

winCondition: Everyone wins together if all 50 number cards (1-10 in five colours) are laid on the ascending and descending stacks; the game is lost immediately when the active player cannot lay a card legally.
notes: family: coop. Cards laid is a progress measure only. Professional version: exactly one card per turn, no number talk.
